diff:
--- a/tests/test_normalize_name.py
+++ b/tests/test_normalize_name.py
@@ -0,0 +1,38 @@
+from app.api.handlers import handle_normalize_name
+
+
+def test_normalize_name_ok():
+    assert handle_normalize_name({"name": "  ada   lovelace "}) == (200, {"name": "Ada Lovelace"})
+
+
+def test_normalize_name_capitalisation():
+    assert handle_normalize_name({"name": "gRACE hOPPER"}) == (200, {"name": "Grace Hopper"})
+
+
+def test_normalize_name_collapses_all_whitespace():
+    assert handle_normalize_name({"name": "a\tb\n c"}) == (200, {"name": "A B C"})
+
+
+def test_normalize_name_single_word():
+    assert handle_normalize_name({"name": "  hello  "}) == (200, {"name": "Hello"})
+
+
+def test_normalize_name_exactly_fifty_characters():
+    name = "a" * 50
+    assert handle_normalize_name({"name": name}) == (200, {"name": "A" + "a" * 49})
+
+
+def test_normalize_name_missing():
+    assert handle_normalize_name({}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+
+
+def test_normalize_name_not_a_string():
+    assert handle_normalize_name({"name": 123}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+
+
+def test_normalize_name_empty_after_normalisation():
+    assert handle_normalize_name({"name": "   \t\n  "}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+
+
+def test_normalize_name_too_long():
+    assert handle_normalize_name({"name": "a" * 51}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
